chapter_name: Agencies and Awards Promoting Health, Sports, and Yoga
learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the organizations that run the sporting world and the prestigious awards that honor athletic greatness!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Organizations like the World Health Organization (WHO) set global health standards and fight pandemics. UNICEF focuses on the health, nutrition, and education of children worldwide.
The apex national sports body in India. It identifies talent, provides world-class training facilities, coaching, and sports scholarships to young athletes across the country.
The International Olympic Committee (IOC) organizes the Olympic Games. Every sport has its international federation (like FIFA for football, ICC for cricket) that makes the rules.

India honors its best: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna (highest sporting honor), Arjuna Award (outstanding performance), Dronacharya Award (for top coaches), and Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy (for universities).
The Ministry of AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy) promotes Yoga globally. The UN recognized June 21 as International Day of Yoga.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 Award Matchmaker
fun_activity.instructions: Think about it: If your favorite athlete wins a gold medal, they get the Arjuna or Khel Ratna award. If their COACH trained them to win, which award does the coach get? (Answer: The Dronacharya Award, named after the legendary guru!)

exam_tips: 📌 Distinguish clearly between the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna (for players) and the Dronacharya Award (for coaches).
📌 Know the full form of SAI and its primary functions in India.
📌 Remember the role of WHO in promoting global community health.
quick_recap: ⭐ The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna is India's highest sporting honor.
⭐ The IOC (International Olympic Committee) is responsible for organizing the Summer and Winter Olympic Games.
⭐ Yoga has gained massive global recognition, backed by the Indian government through the Ministry of AYUSH.
